Cookie Policy

Terms & ConditionsPrivacy PolicyCookie PolicyShipping & DeliveryRefunds & SubscriptionsAccessibilityVersion 2026-10-16

Working draft — inventory required. Audit the production Squarespace site and every embedded, payment, analytics, social, and advertising technology. Add the verified cookie name, provider, purpose, duration, and category before publication.

Cookies and similar technologies can store or read information on a device. This prototype provides equally accessible controls to accept all, reject nonessential technologies, or manage categories. Optional categories remain off until a visitor makes a choice.

Categories

Necessary

Required for requested functions such as security, cart state, checkout, accessibility preferences, or remembering cookie choices. These cannot ordinarily be disabled through the consent tool.

Analytics

Helps understand aggregated visits, interactions, and performance. It should load only after consent where required.

Preferences

Remembers optional presentation or service choices. It should load only according to the visitor’s selection.

Advertising

Supports advertising measurement, personalization, or cross-site tracking. No advertising technology should be enabled unless it is actually needed, accurately disclosed, and permitted by the visitor’s choice and applicable law.

Current prototype behavior

This local prototype stores the consent choice in the visitor’s browser and does not load third-party analytics or advertising scripts. Production behavior may differ after Squarespace integrations are configured; the published policy must describe the production site, not this prototype.

Changing a choice

Select to reopen the controls. A new preference event should be recorded without erasing the earlier consent record. Where legally applicable, production systems should also honor recognized opt-out preference signals such as Global Privacy Control.

Cookie inventory

The production inventory should be maintained with the site release record and updated whenever a vendor, embed, or script changes. Do not classify an analytics or advertising tool as “necessary” merely because it benefits the business.

Contact

Questions about these technologies or choices: the concierge. See the Privacy Policy for broader information practices.

This preview’s storage inventory

The browser stores your essential cookie preferences as eternaluxe-privacy-v1 and an opaque consent receipt as eternaluxe-receipt-v1. No advertising, external analytics, remote fonts or social embeds load. Optional first-party interaction events are sent only when analytics is enabled. Preference changes append a new event.
